fact: The Minister for Transport launched the Passenger Complaints Portal at the Ghana Civil Aviation Authority, a web portal and terminal QR-code channel for air passengers to report, track and resolve complaints, with email and SMS acknowledgement.

The World Bank blog says the BRR unit's 'Have Your Say' platform lets companies voice complaints on regulatory bottlenecks and suggest improvements, and is still in the initial stages of implementation.

A UNFPA/UNDP Peacebuilding Fund project with the Upper West Regional Coordinating Council introduced a mobile app for lodging complaints about security, social, justice and health services, with providers trained in two districts.

fact: CHRAJ says its Electronic Case Management System, which gives complainants a tracking number, has its rollout stalled for want of a networking consultant.
The Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolitan Assembly launched Twin-City Connect, an e-government platform for service delivery, citizens' complaints and information, with no case numbers given.

The Ghana Statistical Service launched a pilot of the Public Services Satisfaction Survey app and USSD *920*158# for anonymous feedback on education, health and ID services in Ga East and Suhum, with nationwide rollout to follow.
